text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential: break large tasks into smaller steps and set mini-deadlines for each one. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so urgent tasks are never left until the last minute. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish; if a task grows too big, reduce it or ask for support. Finally, communication is key. Tell your team or manager early if a deadline is at risk, and suggest solutions. With these four habits, deadlines become less stressful and much easier to meet.
